content: 2026 Python packaging golden path: uv as the project/dependency/build driver, hatchling as build backend, pyproject.toml only, src/ layout for libraries, console_scripts entry point via [project.scripts]. Typer (on Click, FastAPI author) is the recommended CLI framework for new type-hint-driven CLIs. Pydantic for schemas (also used by Copilot SDK @define_tool). Optionally packageable as a Workshop SDK (sdkcraft) for repeatable deployment.
